import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    P = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + N]]

    def f(K):
        if K < 0:
            return 0
        tree = [0] * (N + 1)
        cur = 0
        r = 0
        total = 0
        for l in range(N):
            while r < N:
                v = P[r]
                s = r - l
                i = v
                q = 0
                while i > 0:
                    q += tree[i]
                    i &= i - 1
                g = s - q
                if cur + g > K:
                    break
                cur += g
                i = v
                while i <= N:
                    tree[i] += 1
                    i += i & -i
                r += 1
            total += r - l
            v = P[l]
            i = v - 1
            q = 0
            while i > 0:
                q += tree[i]
                i &= i - 1
            cur -= q
            i = v
            while i <= N:
                tree[i] -= 1
                i += i & -i
        return total

    ans = f(K) - f(K - 1)
    print(ans)

            return 0
        bit = [0] * (N + 1)
        size = 0
        inv = 0
        l = 0
        total = 0
        for r in range(N):
            p = P[r]
            # gain of adding p to window [l, r-1]
            while True:
                s = 0
                i = p
                while i > 0:
                    s += bit[i]
                    i &= i - 1
                g = size - s
                if inv + g <= T or l >= r:
                    break
                # remove P[l]
                q = P[l]
                s2 = 0
                i = q - 1
                while i > 0:
                    s2 += bit[i]
                    i &= i - 1
                inv -= s2
                i = q
                while i <= N:
                    bit[i] -= 1
                    i += i & (-i)
                size -= 1
                l += 1
            # add p
            inv += g
            i = p
            while i <= N:
                bit[i] += 1
                i += i & (-i)
            size += 1
            total += r - l + 1
        return total

    print(f(K) - f(K - 1))

        for l in range(N):
            while r < N:
                x = P[r]
                # count of window values <= x
                c = 0
                i = x
                while i > 0:
                    c += tree[i]
                    i -= i & (-i)
                add = (r - l) - c  # window values greater than x
                if cur + add > K:

                cur += add

                    tree[i] += 1

                x = P[l]

                i = x - 1

                    c += tree[i]
                    i -= i & (-i)
                cur -= c
                i = x
                while i <= N:
                    tree[i] -= 1
                    i += i & (-i)
        return total

    ans = g(K) - g(K - 1)
